style: Dark, melancholic 1980s sci-fi film synth score for a lonely retro pixel-art space game, deep space ambient: slow-evolving retro analog synthesizer pads with filter sweeps, a soft low 16th-note arpeggiator, a sub-bass drone on a pedal tone, a sparse lonely lead with slow vibrato, tape echo and vast reverb, lots of space, muted celesta, sparse plucked glass tones, a low bowed cello and soft analog synthesizer pads. Frost drifts through an abandoned signal hall. Distant glass chimes answer a lonely repeating electronic figure. Cold, lonely, mysterious and desolate. Purely instrumental. Em, 100 BPM.
